# Skyscanner Australia

> > Skyscanner Australia is a leading travel search and price comparison platform helping users find flights, hotels, and car rentals across multiple providers including Kayak, Momondo, and Expedia.

Skyscanner operates as a travel metasearch engine that aggregates deals from hundreds of travel providers, offering features like Price Alerts and 'Everywhere' search to help Australian travelers discover and compare the best travel options. The platform emphasizes transparency, user benefits, and comprehensive travel search capabilities.
